name: Look Keo Classic 3 Plus pedals

specs.weight: 350g per pair including cleats and hardware

spec_notes: made in France
composite body w/ stainless steel platform & cro-mo spindle
multi-tensioner resistance adjustable from 8 to 12Nm
large contact surface area for a high level of pedaling comfort

description:
